messages:
hana_cs: Flagging a small incident - a subset of onboarding jobs for private tenants in APAC are stuck 'processing' after a schema migration. Affected: OrbitLabs (tenant-5501), PaperTrail (tenant-5510). Need comms and credit guidance.

derek_eng: investigating. looks like a mismatch between new schema validator and legacy queued payloads -> requeue failures. patch ready to bypass strict validation for queued items.

mike_support: customers asking for ETA. can we send a one-line status to both now?

leah_csm: yes please. suggest: "We're aware of temporary onboarding delays; engineers are applying a targeted fix; expected resolution within 45-75 minutes." Also note we should offer pro-rated credit and a short onboarding review call for enterprise.

derek_eng: hotfix deployed 2965432110, started low-concurrency replays. OrbitLabs cleared; PaperTrail ~70% processed.

compliancebot: Credit policy check complete  credit approved as pro-rated service credit for impacted time window.

hana_cs: Draft to send: 

"Hi <CustomerName>,

We experienced a temporary delay processing onboarding items due to a schema validation mismatch after a migration. Engineers have applied a hotfix and reprocessing is underway. Most accounts will be caught up within 45-75 minutes. We're applying a pro-rated service credit for the affected window; enterprise customers may request a short onboarding review call. Reply if you'd like us to prioritize specific activation items.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference CS"

mike_support: Sent to OrbitLabs. Holding PaperTrail until fully processed.

leah_csm: I'll schedule the enablement call offer for PaperTrail and add renewal-risk note (low risk).

derek_eng: will open postmortem with change diff and add a pre-migration checklist item to validate queued payload compatibility.

hana_cs: closing this thread for now. reopen if any regressions.
